LanguageData.NR_TransitionRumour: Forum rumour: corporate black labs are copying people into the net. "A digital afterlife," says one deleted post.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionRumourMsg: A strange rumour runs through the feed: corporate labs that move minds into the net.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionContact:
A message comes through a channel no fixer admits to owning. The sender calls themselves {0}: a former employee of a corporate black lab, now running.

"You heard the rumour. It is true. They call it the digital afterlife: a mind moved into the net, whole. The method is split into five blueprints, kept in their labs. I sell coordinates. You do the rest."

The insider now waits in the Club: lab coordinates for {1} cyberdata and {2} silver.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderDesc: A former employee of a corporate black lab. Sells the coordinates of labs where the Transition's blueprints are kept. Labs have Black ICE and ask for an advanced cyberdata at the door.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderBuyTip: A lab appears on the corporate ground of the map for {0} days. A clean dive may bring a blueprint (certain after two clean dives without one). The dive adds 15 Heat.
LanguageData.NR_InsiderLabActive: {0} is still waiting on the map.
LanguageData.NR_LabCodeNames: Lazarus,Ark,Elysium,Straylight,Glass Orchid,Silent Choir,Chrome Lotus,Zero Meridian,Neon Cathedral,Ghost Orchard,Paper Moon,Sleeping Saint,Mirror Abbey,Hollow Crown,Black Lantern,Sable Echo,Iron Lullaby,Velvet Static,Saint Kilda,Cold Harbor
LanguageData.NR_LabFound: {0} sends the coordinates: {1}, on the corporate ground of the map. They stay valid for {2} days.\n\nBlack ICE, two forks; the door takes an advanced cyberdata. A clean exit may bring a blueprint.
LanguageData.NR_LabNoPrint: {0}: no blueprint this time, but the logs point to the next lab.
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_1: From the files of {0}, internal memo: "Subject 7 kept talking for 40 minutes after the body flatlined. In the buffer. She asked for her cat. We are calling it continuity, not survival, for the lawyers."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_2: From the files of {0}, experiment log: "Copy drift under 0.3% after a week. The copy still dreams. Board wants a product name. Marketing proposes 'Digital Afterlife'. Nobody in the lab laughs."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_3: From the files of {0}, a deleted message: "If anyone finds this: the body does not die. It just stays. We keep them in the pods. We tell the families nothing."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintNote_4: From the files of {0}, the director's note: "Project frozen. Too many volunteers. The net is filling with people who do not want to come back. The board calls it a liability. I call it the first honest door out."
LanguageData.NR_BlueprintsAll: The fifth blueprint fits the others. The method is whole: the research "the Transition" can now be started.\n\nWhen it is done, a colonist with a cyberlink can cross into the net from a powered cyberpod. The body stays behind as an empty shell.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionResearchPrints: Blueprints found: {0} / {1} (all are needed to start).
LanguageData.NR_TransitionResearchHidden: Something the corporations keep in their black labs. Follow the rumours in the net.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBeginDesc: Moves this colonist's mind into the net. Takes {0} hours; the pod must stay closed and powered. Heat rises while it runs, and the corporations may send a purge team.\n\nThe body stays in the pod as an empty shell. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.NR_UploadConfirm: {0} will leave the body for good and cross into the net. The upload takes {1} hours; opening the pod before the end may kill them.\n\nBegin the Transition?
LanguageData.NR_UploadProgressDesc: {0}'s mind is moving into the net. Do not open the pod.
LanguageData.NR_UploadInRun: {0} is out in the net: end the run first.
LanguageData.NR_UploadStarted: {0} begins the Transition: {1} hours in the pod.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBroken: The upload of {0} was torn off halfway. The mind snapped back into a body it had half left: a heavy Netsick, but alive.
LanguageData.NR_UploadBrokenDeath: The upload of {0} was torn off halfway. Half a mind came back, and it was not enough. {0} is dead.
LanguageData.NR_UploadDone:
The last packet goes through. {0} is in the net now: awake, whole, free of the body.

Their last words in the colony's channel: "{1}"

The body sleeps on in the pod, an empty shell.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_0: Leave the light on. I can see it from here.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_1: It is so quiet. Nothing hurts.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_2: Tell the others I made it.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_3: I can hear every server on the planet breathing.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_4: Do not wait for me. I am already everywhere.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_5: Feed the animals. I will check the logs.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_6: The body was only the first dive.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_7: I see the stars from the satellites. They are close.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_8: I am not gone. Just further away.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_10: It feels like waking up, not falling asleep.
LanguageData.NR_TransitionWords_11: Keep my pod warm. Just in case.
LanguageData.NR_Epilogue:
The colony is quiet. The pods hum, the shells sleep, and somewhere in the net a small crew keeps running, without bodies, without end.

Those who crossed over:
{0}

You can end the story here, or play on: someone always wanders in to an empty base.
